findings.title: 216 missing exercise statements
findings.explanation: VIII/22--VIII/30 each contain 24 exercise bodies consisting only of "Exercise N". They are not mathematical questions. The new hints are inferred from the preserved solutions, explicitly marked as solution-derived in the bank metadata; they cannot make those statements complete. An independently approved statement-restoration patch is required before a pedagogy release.

findings.title: Deck transformations: domain of a lift
findings.explanation: The solution calls deck transformations lifts of the identity. A deck transformation h:E->E satisfies p h=p: it is a lift of p through p, and lies over the identity of the base. A lift of id_X through p is instead a section X->E. The original solution is preserved.

findings.title: Free-word reduction stops too early
findings.explanation: The word a b a^{-1} a b^{-1} b reduces to a b. After the terminal b^{-1} b cancels, a^{-1} a still cancels. The assertion that no further inverse pair occurs is false. The original solution is preserved.

findings.title: Disk-pair connecting map at n=1
findings.explanation: The solution identifies both H_n(D^n,S^{n-1}) and H_{n-1}(S^{n-1}) with Z and calls the connecting map an isomorphism. This requires n>=2 in ordinary homology. For n=1 the target is H_0(S^0)=Z^2; the map has image the augmentation kernel. A reduced target also repairs the formulation.

findings.title: Reduced versus ordinary cone chains
findings.explanation: Any direct equivalence between ordinary singular chains of the topological cone and the algebraic cone needs a reduced/augmented convention or an explicit degree-zero adjustment. The algebraic cone of the identity is acyclic, while a nonempty contractible topological cone still has ordinary H_0=Z. The added hints state this distinction; the source exposition is not rewritten.

findings.location: Classification by clutching; Real line bundles over the circle
findings.title: Real clutching classification needs an equivalence convention
findings.explanation: The raw set [S^{n-1},O(k)] is not an unrestricted classification of unframed real bundles as written. At n=k=1, [S^0,O(1)] has four maps up to homotopy, whereas there are two real line bundles over S^1. Changes of hemisphere trivializations identify clutching data. Fix orientation/framing conventions or quotient by the appropriate changes of trivialization.

findings.title: Rank-one exception to the sphere obstruction formula
findings.explanation: The displayed primary obstruction formula using pi_{r-1}(S^{r-1})=Z requires r>=2 in this form. For rank one the sphere fiber is S^0 and the obstruction discussion is different; an oriented real line bundle is trivial. The new hint makes the rank restriction explicit without modifying the solution.
